headline: St. Thomas Aquinas pull clear as the last unbeaten side
dek: St. Thomas Aquinas's narrow win at Staten Island takes them clear of D'Youville at the top, and Roberts Wesleyan's win over Molloy leaves St. Thomas Aquinas the only side yet to lose in conference play. Mercy's win over Queens keeps them third, behind D'Youville.
displaced_by: St. Thomas Aquinas beat Staten Island and now lead alone, and Molloy lost to Roberts Wesleyan, so neither the shared lead nor Molloy's unbeaten conference record holds.
